title: Implement the P1 corrective review loop
purpose: Implement the bounded visible local À revoir loop from the latest stored activity result while preserving completion semantics, QCM/fill behavior, persistence, resume, accessibility and Learn-it Next storage isolation.
invariants: completed remains activity submitted or seen and is not redefined by review status.
The review queue is a deterministic projection of the latest progress record for each authored activity.
A latest incorrect result includes an activity exactly once and a later correct result removes it.
No mastery, retention, certification or durable-learning claim is introduced.
The learnit.kit.v2 contract, JSON Schema, RC718 and golden kits remain unchanged.
No IndexedDB store, key, database version, namespace or migration is introduced.
QCM, fill, import, refresh, resume, keyboard focus and native accessible controls are preserved.
requiredEvidence: Exact changed paths are limited to the five allowed files.
Static syntax checks pass for all modified JavaScript files.
Developer checks cover QCM, fill, completed semantics, latest-incorrect inclusion, later-correct removal, uniqueness, deterministic order and review resume.
Manual smoke covers error to À revoir to reload/resume to success/removal.
Independent QA is performed separately before integration.
nonGoals: Independent QA, integration, merge or release.
Contract, schema, storage, CI or governance evolution.
Mastery scoring, spaced retention, backend synchronization or broad UX redesign.
rollback: Discard or revert the single DEV commit. No contract, storage schema, RC718 source, QA file, manifest, workflow or release artifact is changed.
